about: Files npm run i18n:extract skips, each with the reason. A single line can be skipped with a trailing // i18n-ignore comment.

files.src/i18n/format.ts: Locale tables (month and weekday names, day periods) per language, not interface copy.
files.src/i18n/locale.ts: Language names in their own language (Español, English), shown untranslated on purpose.
files.src/assistant/fixtures.ts: Development-only scripted model replies (content, not interface copy); never in a release bundle.
files.src/integrations/evidence.ts: Protocol labels sent to the Assistant server; the interface shows evidence from fact ids.
files.src/storage/database.ts: Storage errors, translated at display time by src/i18n/errors.ts from their exact text.
files.src/storage/transaction.ts: Storage errors, translated at display time by src/i18n/errors.ts.
files.src/storage/LedgerProvider.tsx: Storage errors, translated at display time by src/i18n/errors.ts.
